header: GROSS VALUE OF PRODUCTS (RS. IN LAKHS)

notes: The above data speaks by itself of the gross value of products earned
by the inmates in the various trades. Uttar Pradesh state has reported the
highest value Rs.973.2 lakhs of product earned by inmates followed by Gujarat
(Rs.676.4 lakhs). However, the value of goods produced per inmate was
highest in Gujarat (Rs.8312.1) followed by Chandigarh (Rs.4947.9),
Maharashtra (Rs.2889.0) and Uttar Pradesh (Rs.2017.3). Further, the gainful
work put in by the jail population not only provides corrective approach to the
mental faculty of the offender, it also goes a long way developing responsive
and respectful attitudes. The prisoners not only develop self confidence and self
esteem out of the valuable labour put in by them, these activities also lead
them towards earning a honourable living in life after release from prison.
